title: 周瑜vs诸葛亮
tagline: 正史 vs 演义 · 谁更有一手？

a.look: crimson and black armor, gold crown
a.voice: proud young male rapper, sharp bright voice, fast confident flow

b.look: white feather robe, dark blue headscarf, white feather fan
b.voice: calm cool male rapper, smooth low deep voice, slow mocking delivery
b.prop_desc: a round fan made of layered white crane feathers on a short dark handle, never a folding fan or a paper fan

a: 二十四岁领兵 江东人叫我周郎
曲有误 周郎顾 耳朵比谁都亮
赤壁那把火 正史写我是主将
曹操的连环船 一夜全烧光
你呢 隆中种地 躲着装神仙
三顾才肯出门 架子大过天
借东风 设个坛 披着头发念半天
风本来就要来 你在台上演
草船借箭 正史是孙权的船在跑
罗贯中一支笔 功劳全往你身上靠
羽扇纶巾 东坡写的是我 你去翻翻稿
连你手里这把扇 都是从我这抄
小乔是我夫人 伯符是我兄弟
江东这片天下 一半是我打下的地
你六出祁山 一寸土都没拿回去
论打仗 你只配在旁边摇扇看戏
b: 公瑾说完了 那孔明就上场
赤壁主帅是你 这个我不抢
史书你赢了 我也鼓个掌
可惜说书的 没一个替你讲
你说风本来要来 那你咋没算到日期
曲子错一个音你都听得出 听不出我的计
拿孙权妹妹当鱼饵 想把刘备钓去
赔了夫人又折兵 全江东都在笑你
舌战群儒 江东一屋子大儒被我说倒
隆中一张图 三分天下我早画好
七擒孟获 木牛流马 哪样你会造
鞠躬尽瘁 死而后已 这几个字你得背牢
草船是谁的 史书说了不算
戏台上唱了几百年 主角都是我这张脸
羽扇纶巾谁拿过 你去问问年画店
家家户户贴的 都是我摇扇的画面
巴丘那一晚 你最后一句喊得最响
既生瑜 何生亮 这名分你亲口给我让

actions.A1: fierce and cocky, chin raised, his free hand tapping his chest on the beat
actions.A2: leaning toward Zhuge Liang with a confident grin
actions.A3: jabbing his free hand toward the camera, then sweeping it wide as if setting a whole fleet ablaze
actions.A7: mockingly imitating a Taoist priest casting a spell, waving his free hand in circles, eyes rolled up, swaying
actions.A8: bursting into mocking laughter between the words
actions.A9: wagging his finger at Zhuge Liang with a mocking smile
actions.A10: shrugging theatrically and shaking his head
actions.A11: reaching over to flick the feathers of Zhuge Liang's white fan with one finger, sneering
actions.A13: tapping his chest proudly, then raising a clenched fist
actions.A15: counting on his fingers with contempt
actions.B1: slowly fanning himself with the white feather fan, a faint knowing smile
actions.B2: unhurried, nodding as if granting a small point
actions.B3: tapping the feather fan against his microphone hand in slow sarcastic applause, then shrugging
actions.B4: with a pitying look toward off-screen right
actions.B5: bringing the tip of his feather fan right up to Zhou Yu's ear, then tapping his own temple
actions.B9: sweeping his feather fan through the air as if drawing a map of three kingdoms
actions.B10: spreading both arms wide toward the cheering crowd
actions.B11: ticking off points on his fingers
actions.B12: solemn, laying the feather fan over his heart
actions.B14: tapping the tip of his feather fan against his own cheek, smiling
actions.B15: lifting the feather fan beside his face to show it off to Zhou Yu
actions.B16: fanning himself slowly in the calm pose of a New Year painting, smiling at the crowd
actions.B17: pointing the fan at Zhou Yu, then up at the sky, laughing
actions.B18: waving the feather fan high over his head, laughing
actions.B_REACT: fanning himself with the white feather fan
actions.CROWD: jabbing his finger at Zhuge Liang
